claims.explanation: Pyrimethamine selectively kills cancer cells that depend on de novo nucleotide biosynthesis, particularly through DHFR and thymidylate synthase (TS) pathways. Sensitive lines likely have high expression of DHFR and/or TS (TYMS) or low expression of the reduced folate carrier SLC19A1, leading to intracellular folate depletion and thymineless death. The virtual cell's similarity to methotrexate and raltitrexed supports this mechanism, and the observed sensitivity of TP53-mutant lines may reflect impaired DNA damage response and cell cycle arrest.
